_doc: Underground list of the bake (P1-041, decisions.md 'Underground structures are their own class (Anmol)'). Read by tools/bake/sources/graphinput.ts; the class is tools/bake/graph/underground.ts. 'underground': below ground whatever the tags say, also ways that are not buildings (a market mapped as land use); each becomes a named underground feature (no shell, no ground cut, no building rule). 'surface': on the ground whatever the tags say. Ids are source ids: way/<osm id>, relation/<osm id> or overture/<GERS id>. An Overture copy of an OSM way follows that way. Footprints whose own tags say below ground (layer or level under 0, location=underground, no floors above with floors below, a subway station building) need no line here.

underground.name: Rajiv Chowk metro station
underground.why: Anmol 2026-11-12: the big footprint inside the CP inner circle is Rajiv Chowk metro station, below ground (OSM also tags it layer -2; Overture's copy has level -2)

underground.name: Palika Bazaar
underground.why: the underground market under Palika Park; OSM maps it as landuse=retail with its shops as rooms on level -2 and -1

underground.name: Jama Masjid metro station
underground.why: Violet Line station below ground; OSM tags it layer -1 with location=surface, so the tags alone do not settle it

surface.name: Chhatta Chowk
surface.why: the covered arcade inside the Red Fort stands at street level; its layer -1 only orders it under the roofed passage
